tasks.title: OMEL Human Brake module — scripts/lib/omel/human-brake.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/lib/omel/human-brake.ts. HumanBrake class with: (1) requireApproval(operation: HighRiskOp): Promise<ApprovalResult> — sends Telegram message to OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID describing the operation, polls the Telegram Bot API (getUpdates) for up to 5 minutes waiting for a reply containing 'yes' or 'approve' (case-insensitive), on approval returns {approved: true, approvedBy: 'telegram', ts}; on timeout or any other reply returns {approved: false, reason: 'timeout'|'rejected', ts} and logs an ABORT event. (2) isHighRisk(operation: string, context: any): boolean — returns true if operation is one of the HighRiskOp types or if context.filePath includes 'orchestrate-agents' or 'clawrouter' or '.env'. (3) HUMAN_BRAKE_DISABLED=true env var bypass — if set, requireApproval() returns {approved: true, approvedBy: 'HUMAN_BRAKE_DISABLED', ts} and logs a disable event. Audit log to logs/omel/human-brake-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Export singleton humanBrake. Interfaces: HighRiskOp = 'file_delete'|'git_reset_hard'|'env_change'|'schema_migration'|'bulk_overwrite'. ApprovalResult = {approved: boolean; approvedBy?: string; reason?: string; ts: string}. File must be <300 lines.
tasks.context: AMD-13 OMEL Sprint 179. HumanBrake is the human-in-the-loop safety gate. Pattern for Telegram polling: use https.request to GET api.telegram.org/bot${TOKEN}/getUpdates?offset=${offset}&timeout=30 (long-poll), check for messages containing 'yes'/'approve' in the last 5 minutes. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID from process.env. Telegram send pattern (fire-and-forget) reuse from scripts/lib/ceo-wallet.ts. JSONL logging pattern reuse from scripts/lib/omel/wipe-witness.ts. Singleton export pattern: export const humanBrake = new HumanBrake(). File must be <300 lines. No destructive writes to existing files.
